channel.title: Generative AI news and analysis | TechCrunch

item.title: Pixi’s new iOS app turns text messages into interactive AR experiences
item.description: Forget stickers, GIFs, and emoji reactions. Pixi is betting that the next evolution of messaging is interactive augmented reality (AR).

item.title: Meta’s new ‘AI Mode’ on Facebook pulls from public info across its platforms
item.description: Meta announced Monday that it's rolling out a wave of new AI features on Facebook, the latest sign of the company's effort to catch up in the AI race and keep users more engaged on the platform.

item.title: Deezer’s new tool can identify AI music from Spotify, Apple Music, and others
item.description: Deezer introduced a tool that scans playlists from Spotify, Apple Music, and other platforms to identify AI music.

item.title: Amazon’s new Alexa+ powered feature can generate podcast episodes
item.description: Amazon’s Alexa+ can now generate custom AI podcasts on demand, as the company expands its assistant into a personalized AI content platform.

item.title: Etsy launches its app within ChatGPT as it continues its AI push
item.description: Etsy's new native app within ChatGPT aims to be a conversational shopping experience for users.

item.title: Google’s Gemini AI assistant is hitting the road in millions of vehicles
item.description: The move signals Google’s push to bring more advanced, conversational AI into the driving experience.

item.title: Google Maps is about to get a big dose of AI
item.description: The new features, announced at Cloud Next in Las Vegas this week, add generative AI capabilities to Google's mapping platform, giving it enhanced visual and data analytics powers.

item.title: AI Dungeon maker Latitude unveils Voyage, a platform for creating AI-powered RPGs
item.description: Latitude's new AI-native platform, Voyage, aims to help gamers create their very own role-playing game.

item.title: It’s not just one thing — it’s another thing
item.description: This sentence construction ("It's not just this — it's that") has become so common in AI-generated writing that it's no longer just a clue that a piece of writing may be synthetic — it's almost a guarantee.

item.title: Exclusive: Runway launches $10M fund, Builders program to support early-stage AI startups
item.description: Runway is launching a $10 million fund and startup program to back companies building with its AI video models, as it pushes toward interactive, real-time “video intelligence” applications.

item.title: Peacock expands into AI-driven video, mobile-first live sports, and gaming
item.description: Peacock is betting on new AI-powered video experiences, vertical clips, and mobile games to help its growth.

item.title: Netflix may have paid $600 million for Ben Affleck’s AI startup
item.description: This deal could rank as among the streaming giant's largest acquisitions ever.

item.title: ChatGPT can now create interactive visuals to help you understand math and science concepts
item.description: Instead of just reading an explanation or looking at a static diagram, users can now engage directly with interactive visuals.

item.title: Netflix buys Ben Affleck’s AI filmmaking company InterPositive
item.description: InterPositive isn't trying to make AI actors or synthetic performances. Rather, the company has created a model that helps production teams work with footage from their own productions to help make edits in post-production.

item.title: Spotify says its best developers haven’t written a line of code since December, thanks to AI
item.description: Spotify credits Claude Code and its internal AI system Honk with speeding up development.

item.title: Amazon to begin testing AI tools for film and TV production next month
item.description: Amazon MGM Studios will reportedly begin a closed beta program in March to test its AI tools to help with film and TV production.

item.title: Roblox’s 4D creation feature is now available in open beta
item.description: Roblox's highly anticipated 4D creation feature has officially arrived in open beta.

item.title: Firefox will soon let you block all of its generative AI features
item.description: Starting with Firefox 148 arriving later this month, users will find a new AI controls section within the desktop browser settings.

item.title: Node-based design tool Flora raises $42M from Redpoint Ventures
item.description: Flora lets customers use image, text, or video to create media assets, including images and video. Users can also use prompts to create modifications to build new nodes with multiple iterations. These generated versions are mapped with each other on a canvas to give you a tractable flow of creation.

item.title: Slackbot is an AI agent now
item.description: Salesforce unveils Slackbot, a new AI agent that allows users to complete tasks across multiple enterprise applications from Slack.
